Eve — great to meet you and thanks for signing up. Short answers:

- We support both org-level GitHub Apps and per-repo tokens. For OSS scanning at scale, org-level GitHub App is the recommended path (install once, read-only permissions by default).
- Yes — there is a self-serve onboarding that lets your team deploy a limited private connector and test model-driven alerts without enterprise SSO or KMS. Enterprise features are optional.

If you'd like a short walkthrough I can do a 30 minute call and bring Jonas (solutions engineer) to show the integration flow and where teams typically hit friction. My available windows this week:
- Wed 6/17 10:00–11:30 PT
- Wed 6/17 15:00–16:00 PT

Or use this scheduling link and pick whatever works: https://calendly.com/redwood-demo/30min?ref=acme

I'll also attach a one-pager that outlines the OSS workflow and quickstart.

Best,
